THGA.description: Time History Ground Acceleration (THGA). Defines the ground acceleration time-history loads for a time history load case, pairing X/Y/Z direction time-history function names with their scale factors and arrival times.

NAME.description: Time history load case name that this ground acceleration set belongs to.

FUNCX.description: X-direction time-history function name. Must reference an existing time-history function whose data type is acceleration/ground-acceleration (type 1 or 2); otherwise the request is rejected.

SCALEX.description: X-direction scale factor applied to the X function.

FUNCY.description: Y-direction time-history function name. Must reference an existing time-history function whose data type is acceleration/ground-acceleration (type 1 or 2); otherwise the request is rejected.

SCALEY.description: Y-direction scale factor applied to the Y function.

FUNCZ.description: Z-direction time-history function name. Optional (empty string means no Z-direction function). If given, must reference an existing time-history function of data type 1 or 2.

SCALEZ.description: Z-direction scale factor applied to the Z function. Only used when FUNCZ references a valid function.

ATIMEZ.description: Z-direction arrival time. Only used when FUNCZ references a valid function.
